shapeSummary: Retracted medium-duty linear actuator lying along X: 40x40 mm rectangular extrusion tube, a rear gear housing box, a 36 mm diameter motor cylinder parallel to the tube on top of the rear housing, a 20 mm diameter extension shaft stub at the front, and a 20 mm diameter rear tab. Each end has a 10 mm through-hole along Z, with hole centers 392 mm apart. Bottom at Y=0, centered in X and Z.
warnings: Cross-section sizes (40x40 tube, 44 mm housing height, 36 mm motor diameter) are visual estimates, not stated dimensions.

Hole centers are placed at x=±196 (392 mm retracted length). The end bosses extend 10 mm past each hole, so the overall X length is about 412 mm, not the 402 mm in the analysis, to leave wall material around the 10 mm holes.
Modeled in the retracted state only; the 250 mm stroke is not represented.
Cable, strain relief, end-cap screws, seal ring, potentiometer, labels and logos omitted.
Motor length and position, and the housing shape, are approximate.

motor = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(60, 0, 0)).center(52, 0).circle(18).extrude(90)
shaft = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(-206, 0, 0)).center(20, 0).circle(10).extrude(28)
tab = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, 0, -15)).center(196, 20).circle(10).extrude(30)
